name: cartographer
description: Story mapping and user journey visualization with Cartographer. Build collaborative story maps, map user journeys, run product discovery sessions, and organize work on a visual board.

interface.longDescription: Cartographer turns ChatGPT into a story mapping specialist. Create spaces and projects, build the journey → step → story card backbone in one call, add personas, customers, milestones and statuses, and read or update existing maps. Bundled skills teach the 3-tier hierarchy, card types and practical story-mapping methodology, and cover the jobs around a map: turning interviews and customer feedback into evidence, slicing an MVP, splitting stories, writing backlog tickets, and building sales discovery maps, mutual action plans and playbooks.
defaultPrompt: Use Cartographer to build a story map for our new onboarding flow.
Use Cartographer to turn this interview transcript into a story map with pains and opportunities.
Use Cartographer to map this prospect's workflow and pains from my discovery call notes.

positive.description: Build a complete three-tier story map in an existing space.
positive.prompt: Create a project called Customer Onboarding in my General space with journeys for discovering the product, signing up, completing setup, and inviting teammates. Include steps, objectives, risks, and open questions.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the project in the General space with four journeys, steps under each journey, and typed story cards (objectives, risks, questions) under the steps, then summarizes what it added.

positive.description: Summarize the backbone of an existing project.
positive.prompt: Find my Mobile Checkout project and summarize its user journey from left to right, including the number of story cards under each step.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Mobile Checkout project and returns its journeys in order, each with its steps and the number of story cards under each step.

positive.description: Add a risk and a question without duplicating existing cards.
positive.prompt: In the Mobile Checkout project, review all existing cards and add a risk about payment-provider downtime plus a question about guest checkout under the most relevant steps.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the existing cards, adds one risk card and one question card under the most relevant steps without duplicating existing cards, and reports where each was added.

positive.description: Preview a cascading deletion without deleting anything.
positive.prompt: In the Mobile Checkout project, show me exactly what would be removed if I delete the Payment journey, but do not delete anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls cards_bulk_delete without confirm to get a preview, lists the Payment journey and the steps and story cards that would be removed, and leaves the project unchanged.

positive.description: Show a story map inline in the conversation.
positive.prompt: Show me the Mobile Checkout story map.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Mobile Checkout board inline in the conversation. The user can expand it to fullscreen and open or edit cards directly.

negative.description: Answers general product-management questions without using Cartographer, because no workspace data or action is needed.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between a product roadmap and a user story map.

negative.description: Does not use Cartographer for calendar scheduling, which it cannot do.
negative.prompt: Schedule a planning meeting with my design team next Tuesday at 10 AM.

negative.description: Does not use Cartographer to generate standalone images, which are outside its story-mapping workflows.
negative.prompt: Generate a polished hero illustration for my landing page.
